description: Find businesses on ServeCounter that take bookings from assistants: by name (`query`, at least 3 letters, such as "studio noord"), by trade (`trade`, such as "barber" or "nail-salon"; the trade's key or its English or Dutch name), by place (`city`, or `latitude` and `longitude` with `radiusKm`, 10 by default and at most 50) and, with `freeOn` (YYYY-MM-DD), only those with a free time that day. Give at least one of name, trade, city or coordinates. Needs no sign-in. Answers up to 20 businesses a page with their address, which the other tools take as `business`; ask again with the answer's `nextCursor` for the next page. How results are ordered, always the same way: nearest first when coordinates are given, then the earliest free time on `freeOn` when it is given, then name A to Z. A `city` alone only limits the results to that city: ServeCounter does not measure from a city's centre, so give coordinates for distance. A city alone is ordered by first free time, then name (the free time needs `freeOn`; without it, by name). There is no paid placement: no business can pay to be listed higher, and the answer says how it was ordered in `orderedBy`. Only businesses whose booking page is live and that allow assistants are listed.

city.description: The city, as it is written in the business's address, such as "Amsterdam". Limits the results to it; it does not rank by distance.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page of this same search.

freeOn.description: A day, YYYY-MM-DD: only businesses with a free time then, the earliest first after distance. At most 40 businesses are checked, in order of distance, then name, and the answer says when a request's limit on work left some unchecked.

latitude.description: Where you are looking from, WGS 84 degrees; needs `longitude`. Results are then the nearest first.

limit.description: How many businesses a page: 20 by default and at most 20.

query.description: Part of the business's name or booking address, at least 3 letters.

radiusKm.description: How far from the coordinates, in kilometres: 10 by default, at most 50.

trade.description: The trade: its key ("barber", "hairdresser", "nail-salon") or its English or Dutch name ("Kapsalon").

name: find_business
title: Find Business
